# rust/testdata

Ground truth from the Go server, used by the Rust ports' tests. Only `go_fixture_hooks.json` is
edited by hand. Everything else is generated by `pbs-devtools` (`rust/crates/devtools`), so do not
edit it.

| File | Producer | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `go_fixture_manifest.json` | `adapter-manifest` (Rust, parses `adapters/*/*_test.go`) | One entry per `adapterstest.RunJSONBidderTest` call (282 runs). Each entry gives the fixture root, the bidder name, the resolved `config.Adapter`/`config.Server` (or the struct literal), fixture counts per directory kind, setup statements and hooks. |
| `go_fixture_hooks.json` | hand-maintained | The hooks overlay. It records the fake clocks, random generators, testing flags and package variables that 8 adapter tests install, and `version.Ver` (empty under `go test`). Each entry pins the detected setup statements and the SHA-256 of the Go test file, together with the expected totals. |
| `go_struct_meta.json` | `go-dump struct-meta` (Go, reflect) | Every named type in openrtb2, openrtb3, native1 (and its request/response packages), adcom1, `openrtb_ext`, `adapters`, each adapter package and `config`. It covers fields, JSON tags, kinds, marshaler methods and exported typed constants. |
| `go_config_defaults.json` | `go-dump config-defaults` (Go) | Every viper key from `config.SetupViper`, with its default, Go type and verified `PBS_*` env name, plus the verified un-prefixed fallback variables that `BindEnv` calls made before `SetEnvPrefix` add (`GDPR_DEFAULT_VALUE` and four others), and the `config.New` result with no config file and no env. |
| `go_bidder_infos.json` | `go-dump bidder-infos` (Go) | `static/bidder-info/*.yaml` as `main.go` loads them, plus the aliases and `config.New` validation errors. |
| `go_bidder_names.json` | `go-dump bidder-names` (Go) | The `BidderName` constants, `CoreBidderNames()`, reserved-name predicates and the `NormalizeBidderName` table. |

Every generated file records `go_commit`, the last commit that touched the Go sources or `static/`.

## Regenerating

From anywhere in the repository (requires the Go toolchain and full git history):

```sh
cargo run -p pbs-devtools -- all            # rewrite every generated file
cargo run -p pbs-devtools -- all --check    # fail if any committed file is stale
cargo run -p pbs-devtools -- adapter-manifest
cargo run -p pbs-devtools -- go-dump <struct-meta|config-defaults|bidder-infos|bidder-names|all>
```

`adapter-manifest` fails, and says what to review, in these cases:

- a run cannot be resolved;
- a test gains or loses setup statements;
- a hooked Go test file changes;
- the run or fixture totals move.

After reviewing the Go change, update `go_fixture_hooks.json` and regenerate.
